html:
The Gabalbara, also written Kabalbara, were an Aboriginal Australian people of central Queensland, in the basin of the Fitzroy River west of Rockhampton.

Little is recorded about them. Linguists group their speech with the dialects of the Biri language. Their neighbours were the Wangan and Gayiri to the west and the Darumbal toward the coast. Sheep and cattle runs spread over these plains in the 1860s, soon after the colony of Queensland was founded.
sum: The Gabalbara, also written Kabalbara, were an Aboriginal Australian people of central Queensland, in the basin of the Fitzroy River west of Rockhampton.
